title: Sweep Request
description: Exported by the app for a photo-assisted Sweep of one Place. The user attaches the photo by hand in the Claude Project; the photo never enters the app. The result schema lives in the Project's standing instructions.

path.description: Full Home Tree path of the target Place, e.g. 'Attic -> eaves closet -> blue bin'.

hint.description: Optional free-text note from the user about what to focus on in the photo.
